capabilities: Embed Plotly charts in notes via plotly code blocks
Write chart data, layout, and config in JSON or YAML
Render Plotly examples inside DataviewJS blocks using a wrapper function
Build plots from note data retrieved through the Dataview API
extras: The basic plotly block only supports static JSON/YAML payloads, not JavaScript from plotly.com; JavaScript rendering requires the Dataview plugin. Some Plotly examples need the d3 library, which the author deliberately excluded and which must be downloaded and imported manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render Plotly charts inside markdown notes.

relations.evidence: this approach require DataView plugin to process JavaScript
you can create plots based on data from you notes which you retrieve via DataView API

summary: Plotly chart renderer that embeds interactive Plotly charts in notes via code blocks with JSON or YAML payloads.
